title: 中国科学技术大学（高新校区）

projection.origin_method: centre of the bounding box of all relation outer rings

boundary_note: The campus relation has disjoint outer parcels and an inner exclusion. boundary is the largest outer for compatibility; boundary_polygons preserves every parcel and hole.

walk_graph.policy: Only consecutive shared OSM nodes within the download bbox; no geometric-intersection shortcuts. Vehicle oneway tags do not restrict walking. foot/access restrictions are respected where tagged; missing restrictions do not certify real-world access.

defaults.note: Missing heights/levels use presentation defaults, not measured or verified building heights.

notice: 建筑与道路来自 OpenStreetMap；人物所在楼栋与行走路线为展示层示意，OASIS 没有位置数据
